import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def main():
    data = input().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    mo = int(data[2])
    
    class ModInt:
        def __init__(self, a=0):
            self.v = a % mo
        @staticmethod
        def pow(a, n=mo-2):
            b = a.v
            r = 1
            while n:
                if n & 1:
                    r = r * b % mo
                b = b * b % mo
                n >>= 1
            return ModInt(r)
        def __iadd__(self, a):
            self.v += a.v
            if self.v >= mo:
                self.v -= mo
            return self
        def __isub__(self, a):
            self.v += mo - a.v
            if self.v >= mo:
                self.v -= mo
            return self
        def __imul__(self, a):
            self.v = self.v * a.v % mo
            return self
        def __itruediv__(self, a):
            assert a.v != 0
            self *= ModInt.pow(a)
            return self
        def __add__(self, a):
            res = ModInt(self.v)
            res += a
            return res
        def __sub__(self, a):
            res = ModInt(self.v)
            res -= a
            return res
        def __mul__(self, a):
            res = ModInt(self.v)
            res.v = res.v * a.v % mo
            return res
        def __truediv__(self, a):
            res = ModInt(self.v)
            res /= a
            return res
        def __str__(self):
            return str(self.v)

    def comb(N_, C_):
        NUM_ = 400001
        if not hasattr(comb, "fact"):
            comb.fact = [0] * (NUM_ + 1)
            comb.factr = [0] * (NUM_ + 1)
            comb.inv = [0] * (NUM_ + 1)
            comb.inv[1] = 1
            comb.fact[0] = 1
            comb.factr[0] = 1
            for i in range(2, NUM_ + 1):
                comb.inv[i] = comb.inv[mo % i] * (mo - mo // i) % mo
            for i in range(1, NUM_ + 1):
                comb.fact[i] = comb.fact[i - 1] * i % mo
                comb.factr[i] = comb.factr[i - 1] * comb.inv[i] % mo
        if C_ < 0 or C_ > N_:
            return 0
        return comb.factr[C_] * comb.fact[N_] % mo * comb.factr[N_ - C_] % mo

    N = int(N)
    M = int(M)
    mo = int(mo)

    dp1 = [ModInt() for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dp2 = [ModInt() for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dp3 = [[ModInt() for _ in range(N + 1)] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dp4 = [[ModInt() for _ in range(N + 1)] for _ in range(N + 1)]

    dp1[0] = ModInt(1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            c = comb(i - 1, j - 1)
            dp1[i] += ModInt(i + 1) * dp1[j - 1] * dp1[i - j] * c
            dp2[i] += ModInt(i + 1) * (dp2[i - j] * dp1[j - 1] + dp1[i - j] * dp2[j - 1]) * c
            dp2[i] += dp1[j - 1] * dp1[i - j] * c * (comb(j, 2) + comb(i - j, 2))
    dp3[0][0] = ModInt(1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(i):
            dp3[i][j] = dp3[i - 1][j]
            dp4[i][j] = dp4[i - 1][j]
            for l in range(1, j + 1):
                c = comb(j, l)
                dp3[i][j] += dp1[l] * dp3[i - l - 1][j - l] * c
                dp4[i][j] += (dp1[l] * dp4[i - l - 1][j - l] + dp2[l] * dp3[i - l - 1][j - l]) * c
        dp3[i][i] = dp1[i]
        dp4[i][i] = dp2[i]

    print(dp4[N][M])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
